changes: CRITICAL: PR-08 source replaced — ekomloven LOV-2003 § 2-7b (repealed) → LOV-2024-12-13-76 § 3-15. Scope updated to GDPR consent standard.
STRUCTURAL: MA-03 → thin pointer to EL-04. No independent AML kap. 16 chunks in MA-03.
STRUCTURAL: DC-04 designated canonical foreldelse subdomain; MO-04 designated alias/pointer. One foreldelsesloven chunk set.
BOUNDARY OB-01/OB-05: ordinary termination of continuing contracts re-pointed to OB-05 (not CL-01). OB-05 extended to cover oppsigelse of løpende avtaler.

BOUNDARY CY-06/IN-04: split re-framed on insolvency-procedural signal (oppbud/konkurs åpnet/bobestyrer → IN-04; otherwise CY-06). Håpløshetstidspunkt added. § 17-1 shared. IN-04 konkurskarantene anchor corrected to §§ 142 ff.
BOUNDARY DR-04: extended to cover injunctions on post-employment commercial restraints. § 15-11 characterised as lex specialis, not tvl. kap. 32.
KEYWORDS CY-02: removed legalistic terms (inhabilitet, styreinstruks, daglig drift); added SME situation phrases; removed styreansvar from positive list.
KEYWORDS OB-01: added SME defect/delay phrases; removed nynorsk avtalebrot; added OB-04 and OB-02 confusers.
KEYWORDS DC-01: added SME urgency phrases; moved betalingsoppfordring to DC-02; added MO-02 confuser.
KEYWORDS IN-01: added SME plain-language insolvency phrases.
KEYWORDS PR-01: removed textbook terms; added mixed NO/EN SME GDPR phrases; added samtykke/cookie/DPA confusers.
CO-RETRIEVAL: OB-02 co_retrieval rule added (paired with OB-01 and DC-04).
GAPS (v2): DPO/personvernombud, lagringstid/retention, cross-border transfers, ordinary termination canonical home in CL domain.
SYSTEMIC NOTE: Tier-2 Høyesterett layer needed for CY-06/IN-04, OB-03, IN-03, DR-04, EL-04. Automated Lovdata repeal check required at ingestion.
